findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: background 0.3s` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: ".callout-panel" has CSS `transform: translateY(-50%)` and a GSAP tween animates x. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateY(-50%)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: yPercent: -50. Example: tl.fromTo('.callout-panel', { yPercent: -50 }, { yPercent: -50, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.
